title: Shop
trust: Looks, coaching and club ownership only. Nothing here changes the tiles you draw, and joining clubs is free.
purchaseFailed: The purchase did not go through. Nothing was charged by the app; try again.
pending: Payment received. It can take a minute to reach your account and will appear on its own.
diamondsUse: Diamonds buy table looks, tile backs, avatar frames, emote packs and win celebrations (150 to 600 each, sets for less). Bonus diamonds are spent first.

coach.body:
Free: the coach at bot tables, the daily puzzle, drills, every lesson, 1 hand review and 1 Puzzle Rush a day, Beginner and Club bots, and joining any club.
Coach Gold: Pro bots and unlimited Puzzle Rush.
The Four Winds Club: everything in Coach Gold, unlimited hand reviews, and creating and running your own clubs.

unavailable.title: Store unavailable on this build
unavailable.body: Purchases are switched off here, so nothing can be bought or granted. Looks and plans you already own still work.
unavailable.serverBody: The game server is not taking purchases right now, so nothing can be bought for money. Diamonds you already have still buy looks, and plans you own still work.

mock: Development build: a test store. Purchases are instant, free and stay on this device until the next sync with the server.
offline: Offline: showing your balance from the last time the app reached the server.
restoredUnchecked: Your store sent your purchases, but the game server could not check them just now. If something is missing, tap Restore purchases again in a minute.

owed.title: %{n} diamonds owed after a refund
owed.body: A diamond pack was refunded after its diamonds had been spent, so your balance is below zero. Diamonds cannot be spent until it is back to zero: the next %{n} diamonds you buy pay it back.

errors.store_product_missing: This item is not on sale in your store yet.
errors.store_not_signed_in: Connect to the game server first, so the purchase reaches your account.
errors.store_unavailable: The store is not available on this build.

foot: Prices come from your App Store or Google Play region. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel them in your store account settings at least 24 hours before the renewal date. Restore purchases brings back subscriptions bought with the same store account; diamonds and looks belong to the game account they were bought on, so sign in with Apple or Google to keep them on a new phone.
